m_26_14.description: Derived-drift sub-pipeline. Called by m_26_14-asset-canonical-enrich (via a pipeline processor with ignore_missing_pipeline) on every document the entity-resolution Transform writes to m_26_14-assets. Bootstrap-only: it uses an enrich processor whose policy (m_26_14-asset-baseline-lookup) is created by load_bootstrap.py, so it cannot live in the EPR package (Fleet would reject a pipeline referencing a not-yet-created enrich policy). Decoupling it keeps the EPR package installable standalone; drift activates once bootstrap runs.

description: Computes m_26_14.drift_detected (mirrored to asset.compliance.drift_detected): true when the asset's current baseline_hash diverges from its certified baseline hash, looked up by asset.id from the frozen m_26_14-asset-baselines snapshot. Replaces the never-built WS3 drift watcher; recomputed on every transform checkpoint so it is stable across re-enrichment.

enrich.description: Look up the certified baseline hash for this asset (by asset.id) from the frozen m_26_14-asset-baselines snapshot. The baseline-snapshot transform is run-once/stopped so this hash is a fixed point-in-time certification.

script.description: Derive m_26_14.drift_detected (and mirror to asset.compliance.drift_detected): true when the asset's current baseline_hash diverges from its certified baseline.

remove.description: Drop the temporary enrich lookup payload
